analysis.intent_details: Inform recipient about new job matches available on Guru.com platform

responses.subject: Re: New Job Matches!
responses.body:
Dear Guru.com Team,

Thank you for sending the new job matches. I have received the notification and will review the opportunities at my earliest convenience.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A simple acknowledgment confirms receipt without requiring further action, matching the informational nature of the email.
